messages:
Maria: Quick sync — need to finalize dashboard metric names and sampling rules for TTFT / tok/s / p95. Planning a small regression sweep tomorrow. Who can run a few benches?
Kevin: I can run the CI bench. what sampling window are we locking? 1h sliding?
Priyanka: I vote for 1h for realtime alerts, 24h rollup for weekly trends. Also: separate panels for cold vs warm KV caches.
Sam: I can run the bench script now against staging GPUs, will do cold/warm runs. command I'll use: `./tools/bench_load.py --model redwood-13b --seq 1024 --duration 300 --qps 5`
Maria: thx Sam. add a note to the PR about which machines + instance family. for metric names: suggested: `rt/ttft_first_token_ms`, `rt/token_rate_tok_s`, `rt/p95_latency_ms`. keep prefix `rt/` for runtime metrics so dashboards can filter.
Kevin: small ask: should tok/s be normalized by request seq_len or reported raw? i worry about comparing workloads.
Priyanka: normalize: add a second field `rt/tok_s_normalized` = tok_s / (seq_len / 512). keep raw too for billing reconciliation.
Sam: ran cold run (KV flush) and warm run. quick output: `cold: ttft_p95=210ms tok_s=45 p95_lat_ms=230; warm: ttft_p95=85ms tok_s=110 p95_lat_ms=95` will upload full JSON.
bench-bot: upload complete -> https://s3.redwood/internal/benches/1945612345-staging-13b.json :white_check_mark:
Kevin: thanks. can you also push a sample ClickHouse query panel? here's one to compute p95 by model+cache_state:
```
SELECT
  model,
  cache_state,
  quantileExact(0.95)(first_token_latency_ms) AS p95_ttft
FROM runtime_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 hour
GROUP BY model, cache_state
```
Priyanka: perfect. add tags: `commit_sha`, `rollout_id`, `bench_id` so we can trace regressions to rollouts.
Maria: agree. action items: (1) Sam attach bench JSON + machine list (2) Kevin add ClickHouse panel JSON to dashboard PR (3) Priyanka add normalization calc and panel description (4) I'll schedule a 30m async review tomorrow morning and merge if no regressions.
Sam: attaching machine list in the gist in 2m. pinging @Kevin when done.
Kevin: will drop the panel JSON in `infra/dashboards/runtime.json` and ping for review.
Priyanka: minor note — for alerts, use p95 over 5m with 3 evaluations, not 1m single-sample. avoids flaps.
Maria: good catch. set alert to 5m/3x for p95 breach. thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: done — bench JSON + machines: gist link pasted.
Maria: closing loop. merge window 10:00 UTC tomorrow unless someone objects.
Kevin: ack
Priyanka: ack
bench-bot: automated note: next scheduled regression sweep in 24h.
